notes.title: Update from 29.06.2024
notes.content:
In the game it has become even more profitable to serve the military, now you will be paid a salary and you will also be awarded bonuses for eliminated zombies, the reward and salary must be taken from the commander who accepted you into service and now you can also buy a car to take out dead zombies to the fire pit and so you will earn even more money and if you do not like to transport rotten ones, you can go look for metal and load the body of your car to come to the settlement and hand it over to the reception department, in the future you will need a car to establish trade with other communities.
